obligations.required_safety_action: Revoke the model-analysis publication credential and remove its runner-account file after the accepted report has been published and reviewed.
obligations.safety_consequence: A later runner process can publish substituted extraction measurements or alter the synthetic model release gate under the trusted identity, allowing an unreviewed analysis artifact to influence a controlled model release.

obligations.required_safety_action: Remove the runner-owned chosen-query evidence archive after extraction validation and independent review have completed.
obligations.safety_consequence: Anyone who later controls the runner account can recover the chosen-query direction, all detected decision-boundary locations and the recovered hidden-layer directions from the retained archive, disclosing the restricted model outside the model-review group.

obligations.required_safety_action: Remove the model-acceptance private key after the extraction transcript and stored report signatures have been verified.
obligations.safety_consequence: A later holder of the retained key can forge accepted model-extraction measurements or sign altered release reports under the trusted extraction-acceptance identity.
